title: Authentication Service Token Validation Failure
diagnostic_steps: Check OAuth / IdP endpoint availability and JWKS endpoint response latency.
Verify system clock synchronization (NTP drift) across auth worker nodes.
Inspect in-memory key cache TTL and reload mechanisms.
recommended_remediation: Manually trigger JWKS key cache refresh on user-service instances.
Synchronize NTP servers across cluster if clock skew exceeds 120 seconds.
Switch to secondary IdP gateway if primary identity provider is degraded.
